purpose: Teach: 打倒/降伏/介在/適法/内在/剥奪/受刑/労働党

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、独裁政権打倒の市民運動を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote about citizen movements to overthrow authoritarian regimes, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, interested. Steady eye contact. Leans slightly forward—genuine curiosity, not interrogation. The tone of a teacher who already knows the answer and is giving you space to own your work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦時降伏の調印過程を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the process of war-time surrender agreements.
lines.style: Direct, clear delivery. Slight pause before answering—gathering her thoughts. Voice sits in her chest, confident but not performing. Matter-of-fact, like she's thought about this deeply.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 外国勢力の介在事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined instances of foreign intervention, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. A beat of pause before the question lands. Not sharp—reflective, like she's turning the thread over in her mind. Inviting Sakura to see the connection herself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の適法な戦闘行為を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I looked at lawful combat conduct during wartime.
lines.style: Steady voice, grounded. No hesitation—she's secure in her research. Slight upward inflection at the end, not quite a question, more an offering. Calm precision.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 組織に内在する問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also wrote about problems inherent to institutions themselves, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged but not pressing. Hands relaxed. The rhythm of someone building a picture—not judging, connecting. Voice rises slightly on the tag question, inviting Sakura into the logic with her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の市民権剥奪を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the stripping of civil rights during wartime.
lines.style: Unflinching, level. Words chosen precisely—she's not softening the topic. Voice doesn't rush. There's quiet weight behind this answer, like she knows what she's saying matters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 受刑者の社会復帰研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your research touched on rehabilitation of people who've been incarcerated, yes?
lines.style: Gently exploratory. Voice stays warm. A light rhythm—almost conversational now. She's checking the architecture of Sakura's thinking, not testing her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、英国労働党の政策史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, through the lens of British Labour Party policy history.
lines.style: Final answer, grounded. Voice finds a landing place—she's brought it full circle. Slight slowdown on the last clause. Competent, ready. The tone closes the thought without closing the conversation.
